high_level_description: This image is a promotional poster for a Tamil film titled "Dhruv Gomuksan." The poster features a black-and-white photograph of two individuals embracing each other tightly. The woman is leaning into the man, with her head resting on his shoulder, and he has his arms wrapped around her. The background is a textured wall, and there is a dramatic effect of flames on the left side of the image, adding a sense of intensity or passion to the scene. The text on the poster includes: "Applause Entertainment & Pa Ranjith Present" "A Nivas K Prasanna Musical"
